title: Home Brain web app — Phase 0/1 mock-up v0.2

Main.dc.html.title: Console — your pages of widgets, Ask, ⚙ (clickable)

t1.text: Home Brain web app — Sprint 14 mock-up (v0.2: pages and widgets)

s1.text:
Clickable on the Console (Play):
• Pages are the menu: Home and Stocks, + adds a page. Edit page → + Add widget → pick a type, pick its data, Add.
• ⓘ on any widget (hover or tap) says where its data comes from and who added it.
• Ask (top bar) opens one conversation drawer. “manage budget” runs the workflow; anything else goes to Novia. Try “put the supplies running low on my home page” → Approve → it appears on Home.
• Needs you → Open the budget question: edit amounts (decimal comma works; letters are refused), Save.
• ⚙: How your brain works (drawn from your own registry), All data (expenses grid, recipe document), Activity, Workflows, Memory, Settings.
• P0 / P1: P0 shows only what Phase 0 builds — Home with Needs you and Conversations, Ask with workflow routing.
• EN / ES: app words and number formats change; your data does not.

All names and amounts are invented sample data.
